title: Brown used ion-wind work to cover for electrogravitics

tellings.quote: And the funny thing is Brown himself would use the electrohydrodnamic stuff the the stuff involving ion wind to cover for the electrogravitics

plain: The inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, Michels says, used his work on ion wind, where charged particles push air along, as a cover for his work on electrogravitics, the idea that high voltage could produce a gravity-like push. Michels offers this as his own view, without naming a source. If true, Brown's ordinary-looking research would have hidden a more radical goal.
